name: codex-auth-imagegen
description: Run Image Gen with the active provider URL and config.toml token, falling back to auth.json when absent.

interface.shortDescription: Use Codex credentials for Image Gen without environment variables.
interface.longDescription: Read the active provider base_url from config.toml and prefer its experimental_bearer_token; fall back to auth.json only when no provider token is configured. Pass the selected key directly to bundled Image Gen clients in memory.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image with my active Codex provider.
Edit this image through Codex Auth ImageGen.
Diagnose my Codex Auth ImageGen configuration.
